Hi, I'm Lukas Lescano. I recently graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara with a Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science, with an emphasis in GIS and Energy & Sustainability.

I'm driven by the challenge of accelerating the clean energy transition through data-informed planning and systems-level thinking. My academic and project work focuses on renewable energy integration, spatial analysis, and strategic approaches to decarbonization.

My recent work includes solar accessibility and transmission line modeling, wildfire risk mapping, spatial interpolation of air quality data, and a solar plus battery storage model built in Excel using NREL's PVWatts.

My focus is on solar and battery storage, from residential systems to utility-scale deployment. I am currently seeking opportunities in renewable energy project development and energy analysis.
